en.title: Accessibility Highlights: Tax Filing Upgrades, Playground Improvements, and Curb Ramp Advocacy
en.summary: Today's digest highlights a new upgrade to the tax filing system adding accessible web operations, a Wilmington playground renovation to improve accessibility for children, and a community complaint about insufficient curb ramps prompting accessibility advocacy.

highlights.title: Tax Filing System Upgrade Adds More Friendly Accessible Web Operations
Wilmington playground getting an upgrade to make it more accessible
Curb Ramp Shortage Prompts Accessibility Complaint

zh-TW.title: 無障礙焦點：稅務申報系統升級、威明頓遊樂場改善及路縫坡不足倡議
zh-TW.summary: 今日摘要報導稅務申報系統新增友善無障礙網頁操作、威明頓遊樂場進行無障礙升級以方便殘障兒童，以及居民因路縫坡不足提出無障礙投訴，推動社區無障礙改善。

highlights.title: 綜所稅報稅系統升級 新增無障礙網頁操作更友善
威明頓遊樂場將進行升級以提升無障礙性
路缘坡不足引发无障碍投诉
